claim: User-managed partition keys are supported in On-Demand Standard, On-Demand Advantage, and Provisioned stream modes. Service-managed record distribution is supported in On-Demand Standard and On-Demand Advantage only, not in provisioned mode. It is not examinable yet.
question: Which stream modes support service-managed record distribution?

values.display: On-Demand Standard and On-Demand Advantage only

qualifiers.scope: per record distribution strategy of a data stream
qualifiers.condition: announced 2026-09-23, after the cutoff, so not examinable yet
